## A note on AI, creativity & contributions

Yes, we use AI. No, we're not pretending every pixel was handcrafted by a sleep-deprived designer at 3 AM.

asocialmedia uses AI-assisted tools for things like illustrations, banners, icons, writing, brainstorming, and code. We're a small independent project with big ambitions and a budget that occasionally resembles a rounding error. These tools help us build things that would otherwise take significantly more time and resources.

But **AI is a tool, not an excuse to stop thinking.**

### AI-generated code? Sure. AI-generated responsibility? Nope.

We welcome AI-assisted pull requests. Whether you use Claude, Codex, Copilot, or something else, we genuinely don't mind.

What we _do_ mind is someone pasting an issue into an LLM, copying the output into a PR, and calling it a day.

If you're submitting code:

- **Understand what you're submitting.** You should be able to explain what your changes do and why they're necessary.
- **Test it locally.** Run the relevant checks, test the affected functionality, and make sure you haven't broken something else.
- **Review the output.** AI can confidently invent APIs, introduce vulnerabilities, and write spectacularly unnecessary abstractions.
- **Keep PRs focused.** Don't rewrite half the codebase to fix a button.
- **Be transparent.** If AI substantially assisted your contribution, mention it. No shame in using tools.
- **Own your changes.** Be available to respond to review feedback and fix problems.

**AI-assisted PRs are welcome. Untested AI slop is not.**

We're not going to reject good code because an LLM helped write it. We're also not going to merge bad code because an LLM said it was production-ready.

### What about the artwork?

Some of asocialmedia's visual assets, including banners, illustrations, and icons, are created or refined with generative AI.

We're open about that. We're also very aware that human designers bring something prompts alone cannot replace: intention, consistency, experience, and an actual understanding of visual identity.

**Designers and artists are absolutely welcome here.**

If you think you can improve our illustrations, refine our branding, create better icons, or take the visual identity somewhere more interesting, we'd love to see your ideas.

You can contribute designs, propose improvements, collaborate with us, or sponsor creative work. We welcome conversations about paid design collaborations too, when funding permits.

We also respect creators' rights. Please don't submit assets that infringe someone else's work or use material you don't have permission to contribute.

### The actual policy

**We care about the work, not which tools helped make it.**

AI-generated, human-made, or somewhere in between — what matters is quality, originality, transparency, security, and the effort put into making something genuinely useful.

Human creativity stays in charge. AI can carry some of the boxes.

And if you have an idea that could make asocialmedia better, reach out at **[hello@asocialmedia.cc](mailto:hello@asocialmedia.cc)**.

We'd rather build something good together than argue over who used autocomplete.
